subject: Re: ClearCart peak spike - temporary overage protection & soft-commit tweak
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@clearcart.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected launch spike — request for short-term protection and lower overage rate

Hi Hannah,

Quick one — we flipped a new marketing creative this morning and are seeing an unexpected 6x spike in requests to our endpoint. We’re already past our soft quota and the throttle is starting to hit user flows.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provision a temporary rate-limit bump for 72 hours (region: us-west) while we scale?
- Can you offer a one-time mitigation on the overage rate or a capped credit so our invoice doesn’t blow the quarter? We’re asking for something like a capped overage credit for the week or a reduced per-token overage for the excess volume.

I attached the May usage export so you can see baseline. We can sign any short amendment if needed — want to avoid a full PO process given the timing.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Platform
ClearCart
Attachments: ClearCart_usage_May2027.csv (CSV export, 1 file)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@clearcart.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected launch spike — request for short-term protection and lower overage rate

Thanks for the heads-up, Sarah — glad you reached out early. We can absolutely help reduce impact while you scale.

High-level proposal (we can finalize after internal sign-off):
- Immediate: enable a temporary rate-limit increase for the impacted project for 72 hours (us-west). No code changes on your side.
- Billing: offer a one-time overage concession covering up to $25k of excess usage OR a 30% discount on overage rate for the excess volume in the 72h window (your choice).
- Documentation: we’ll prepare a short amendment (electronic signature) that captures the start/end time and the credit path.

I’ll need a quick internal approval for the $25k concession (or equivalent discounted overage). I’ve looped in Ben and Karthik to expedite. If you prefer the discount instead of the capped credit, say the word and we’ll reflect that in the amendment.

Planning question: do you want us to enable autoscaling on dedicated capacity or just the transient rate bump? If you expect sustained elevated traffic beyond 72h, we should talk about a short-term commit increase.

Standby — I’ll follow up within the hour with next steps.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: ClearCart spike — request for 72h rate bump + overage concession (usage attached)

Forwarding ClearCart’s note — they’re live with a marketing push and request a 72h rate bump + either a $25k capped credit or 30% off overage for the excess. Attached is their May baseline.

My suggested concession (to move quickly and preserve goodwill):
- Approve temporary rate-limit upgrade for 72h (ops can flip the config).
- Offer the capped credit option: up to $20k (we eat the delta) and require Simple Amendment (no PO) signed in 48h; OR 25% off overage rate for the excess during the window.
- Condition: this applies only to the specific project/service id in the amendment; sustained increases must be handled via a short-term commit or Dedicated switch.

Why smaller than their ask: preserves precedent and keeps Finance exposure limited. If we push $25k, we risk setting a pattern.

Ops impact: we need an SRE to enact the rate change and verify it doesn’t affect other tenants. Ben — can you confirm ops capacity and finance tolerance? Karthik — need your view on the wording for the amendment (we’ll send a DocuSign link).

Attachments: ClearCart_usage_May2027.csv

Thanks,
— Hannah
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearCart spike — request for 72h rate bump + overage concession (usage attached)

Hannah — good catch. Ops can do the rate bump; I’ll ask SRE to apply a scoped policy to only the ClearCart project and to set an automatic rollback at +72h.

Finance check: Laura, can we approve up to $20k one-time credit against overage for a strategic customer, conditioned on a signed amendment that includes a clause preventing repeated use within a 6-month window? If we approve a percentage discount instead, is there any accounting/recognition complication?

Karthik — please draft the amendment language minimal: start/end times, credit cap OR discount, affected project id, DocuSign link, and signature block. If Laura confirms finance, we’ll sign off and I’ll authorize Ops to flip the switch.

Ben
Senior Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearCart spike — request for 72h rate bump + overage concession (usage attached)

Approved up to $20,000 one-time credit. Conditions:
- Amendment must be signed prior to the start of the credit window (DocuSign OK).
- Credit applied only to overage charges for the specified project id and the 72h window.
- Include a clause that prevents the same concession being granted more than once in any 180-day period.
- We will need a short memo for billing to show the credit reason and GL account.

If customer prefers a discount instead of a cap, Finance is OK with a 25% discount for the excess during the window — but the signed amendment must call that out and include the same recurrence restriction.

I’ll work with Billing to ensure the ledger entry is prepared. Ben/Hannah please send me the signed amendment and the DocuSign event id.

— Laura
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@clearcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected launch spike — ClearCart temporary uplift & credit (next steps)

Hi Sarah — quick update and the path forward. Thanks for the usage file — it helped the internal review.

What we can do now (approved):
1) Ops will enable a scoped rate-limit uplift for the ClearCart project for 72 hours starting when you confirm. We’ll configure an automatic rollback at the end of the window.
2) Finance approved a one-time overage concession up to $20,000 OR a 25% discount on the excess volume during that 72h window. Please let us know which option you prefer and we’ll reflect that in the amendment.
3) Amendment: we prepared a short amendment (DocuSign link below). It includes the project id, start/end times, the cap vs discount option, and a 180-day recurrence restriction. We need a signed copy before Ops flips the switch.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/clearcart/soft-commit-amendment
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/CL-2027-0943

If you want us to start immediately, sign the amendment and reply here. Once we have the signature event id, Ops will enact the uplift and I’ll copy billing so the credit is tracked.

If you expect traffic to remain elevated beyond 72h, recommend we talk about a short-term commit (7/30) — we can do a blended rate for the period instead of repeated concessions.

Standing by — we’ll prioritize the amendment and the SRE work.

Best,
Hannah
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
